interpretation: Kernel stages and PL active time overlap ioctl. Do not sum them with host stages. Input and output stalls may overlap each other across lanes; never subtract their sum as pure compute time. Work window spans last input handshake to first output valid, including initial output read latency. IO overlap counts simultaneous external handshakes; work overlap includes that initial read clock. Bounds subtract 256 cycles/frame for multi-work and 256 for all-four-work. Coherent HP0 copies included. Four simultaneous FFT CALC windows are not required; each core executes two butterflies per issue. Issue/retire events and CALC lane cycles sum across cores and can exceed wall cycles. Separate unprofiled paired trials are required for performance comparisons.
